content.thinking: Payment 81's journal matches its payment amount, so that's just a payment-vs-invoice discrepancy. Next I'll check journal line account patterns, AP posting accuracy, payment journal periods, and the reversal.

input.sql: select h."SRC_CD", trim(l."ACCT_CD") a, case when l."DR_AMT">0 then 'DR' else 'CR' end s, count(*) from "GLJRNL" l join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."PRD_ID" correct_prd, pay."PAY_DT" from "APPAYM" pay join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||pay."PAY_ID" join "GLPERD" p on pay."PAY_DT" between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" where p."PRD_ID"<>h."PRD_ID" or pay."PAY_DT"<>h."POST_DT"
select * from "GLJRNH" where "REF_JRNL_NO" is not null or "JRNL_NO" in (2439,2469,2470,2471) or "PRD_ID">=11 and "SRC_CD"='GL' order by 1

select "JRNL_NO", count(*) c from "GLJRNH" group by 1 having count(*)>1 union all select "INV_ID", count(*) from "APINVH" group by 1 having count(*)>1 union all select "PAY_ID", count(*) from "APPAYM" group by 1 having count(*)>1
